title: Салат из редиски со сметаной
notes: Units without dots ('ст л', 'ч л') and glued to the number ('250г'). Lower-case names → capitalise. 'чеснок головка' = unit word without a number and 'головка' is out of vocabulary → amount null, unit null. 'зелень укроп петрушка' is a category word followed by two herbs separated only by spaces → split into Укроп and Петрушка (acceptable alternative: a single 'Зелень'). ALL-CAPS title with a trailing dot and a trailing space. The last line is a hashtag block whose FIRST word has no '#' ('вкусно #редиска …') and that mixes bare words and a double space — must not be read as an ingredient. No steps.
